description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for the LoanCharge entity, providing methods for accessing LoanCharge records, including querying by external ID and filtering by loan ID and due date.

classes.name: LoanChargeRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing LoanCharge entities, providing methods for standard CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a LoanCharge entity based on its external ID.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndFromDueDate
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanCharge entities associated with a specific loan ID, with due dates on or after a specified date.
